title: Slow Barbados, side streets and quiet rum shops
summary: A relaxed five-day loop through Barbados built around early mornings, small neighborhood walks, and one unhurried fish fry. Skips the cruise-port bottlenecks in favor of east-coast beaches, a couple of half-day bus rides, and the rum shops the regulars actually drink at.
pace: One anchor activity per day, lots of unstructured wandering.

logistics.transit: Two legs by local bus, otherwise on foot
logistics.bestTime: Early mornings and just after sunset for popular beaches

highlights: A 7am walk on the empty Crane Beach before the taxis arrive
An afternoon at a family-run fish fry the model picked from a side street
A half-day in Bathsheba before the surf tour buses arrive
